تقتعدين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَعِدِينَ (taqtaʕidīna) /taq.ta.ʕi.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# تُقْتَعَدِينَ (tuqtaʕadīna) /tuq.ta.ʕa.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
